thread:
ravi: Heads-up: planning a conservative v2 flip for the split-route tomorrow morning. Goal: validate header negotiation and streaming session stability. Scope: us-east only, 15% traffic, 20m canary.
ellie: thanks. what's the exact header and query fallback? some clients use client-version query param.
ravi: primary signal: X-API-Version: 2. fallback: client-version=v2 query. if neither present we treat as v1 until cutoff.
sam: ops note: keep pin tool ready. mobile proxies sometimes strip query params, so prefer header-first.
infra-bot: pin CLI alias: `pin-tenant --route split-route --tenant TENANT_ID --to v1 --reason "compat-issue"`
ravi: preflight checklist: 1) compatibility probe over last 3 days, 2) canary dashboard ready (p50/p95/5xx), 3) deploy-bot schedule + auto-pin enabled, 4) release-notes draft updated.
ellie: ran probe: ~0.4% requests lack either signal in us-east; mobile ~1.3%. Not huge but non-zero.
sam: recommend disable ap-southeast for this initial flip. Also flag proxy.502 alert.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: split-route -> v2 at 1751237400. Canary window: 20m. Auto-pin: enabled (threshold=40% 5xx in 120s). Will emit canary snapshots at +3m, +10m, +20m.
ravi: release note draft: "v2 introduces structured streaming and stricter request framing. Clients without explicit API version will remain on v1. See migration notes for malformed payload handling"
ellie: ops: paste rollback snippet for quick access please.
sam: rollback quick: `deploy-bot rollback --route split-route --to v1` then `infractl remove-canary split-route` and check `/ops/pins` for any auto-pins.
ravi: also enable structured-logs sampler so we can capture 1% of requests end-to-end during canary.
infra-bot: structured-logs sampler set to 1% for route split-route during canary window.
(After start)
infra-bot: Canary snapshot +3m: p50 +8ms, p95 +60ms, 5xx = 4. No tenant breaches.
ellie: watch client-429 anomalies; rate-limited clients might surface differently under v2 header parsing.
sam: alert rule added: client.429.count > 20 in 3m -> notify ops.
(10m)
infra-bot: Canary snapshot +10m: p50 +6ms, p95 +72ms, 5xx = 12 (small cluster, clustered around tenant-2247).
deploy-bot: Auto-pin triggered: tenant-2247 -> pinned to v1 at 1751238034. Reason: sustained 5xx >40% in 120s.
ravi: can we get a sample request from tenant-2247 from structured logs?
infra-bot: Sample saved: /logs/structured/175123/tenant-2247/sample-1.json
ellie: quick inspect: client sent an extra trailing comma in event array which v2 validator rejects. v1 tolerated it.
sam: ops: we've pinned them and notified support to reach out. continue roll but hold aggressive increase.
ravi: agreed. postpone ramp until we validate a regression test and add a quick mitigation in docs.
(20m)
infra-bot: Canary snapshot +20m: p95 stable, 5xx trend declining. No new auto-pins.
deploy-bot: Current state: 15% us-east on v2, 1 auto-pin. No rollback initiated.
ellie: follow-up: add a unit/regression test that rejects trailing-commas equivalence to enforce v1->v2 compatibility check. Ticket created: INF-4749.
sam: ops will add tenant-2247 to troubleshooting FAQ with sample payload and client fix.
ravi: final: update release notes with pin command, auto-pin behavior, and tenant example. Keep change window open 3h for late regressions. If anything >5xx spike over baseline +30% then we rollback.
ellie: noted and published short release note addendum.
(2h later)
infra-bot: Postmortem-lite: one auto-pin (tenant-2247) due to trailing comma parsing. No system rollback. Rolling this thread to closed status.
ravi: thanks all. Will schedule a follow-up patch to accept a lenient parsing mode behind a runtime flag for migration grace.
